package.name: cortex_gui
package.description: GUI egress layer: bridges internal ROS state to the ROS-free display renderer (kist-drl-g1-gui). gui_bridge_node subscribes to the orchestrator's TaskStatus (and optionally a camera topic) and re-serves them over a WebSocket in the renderer's REQ-41 contract — a thin adapter, no logic. Kept out of cortex_perception on purpose: this is presentation egress, not sensing, and its web-server dependency should not leak into the perception packages.
